first.rationale: The immediate competitive loss is concentrated in price-sensitive SMB, where targeted promotional pricing previously lifted acquisition and revenue. Verify both pricing durability and the competing onboarding evidence before committing; use a guarded segment-specific test because discounting can impair long-term value.

final.rationale: Run a standard experiment to simplify onboarding. Completion is currently down 4%, and the verified onboarding result improved completion by 13%, reduced time-to-value by 2.1 days, and increased 30-day retention by 3%, directly supporting sustainable qualified revenue. Signup simplification also previously improved SMB activation. Do not use promotional pricing: its verified revenue lift came with a 12% 30-day retention decline and was explicitly not sustainable.
